# @buildanagent/protocol

> The wire types of the buildanagent harness: the session entry union, the client and server messages and their JSONL framing.

The sections of README.md and every public export, generated from this package's README and declaration files in the same commit as its code.

## Docs

- [Install the alpha with `pnpm add @buildanagent/protocol@alpha`](README.md#install-the-alpha-with-pnpm-add-buildanagentprotocolalpha)
- [A session file is a list of entries, one per line](README.md#a-session-file-is-a-list-of-entries-one-per-line)
  - [`parseEntry()` reads a line and refuses a format it does not know](README.md#parseentry-reads-a-line-and-refuses-a-format-it-does-not-know)
  - [The JSON Schema describes every entry for other languages](README.md#the-json-schema-describes-every-entry-for-other-languages)
- [The protocol is JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line](README.md#the-protocol-is-json-rpc-20-one-message-per-line)
  - [The framer splits on newlines only](README.md#the-framer-splits-on-newlines-only)
  - [The protocol schema covers every message](README.md#the-protocol-schema-covers-every-message)
- [Over stdio, each message is one line, and stdout carries nothing else](README.md#over-stdio-each-message-is-one-line-and-stdout-carries-nothing-else)
  - [Two outside JSON-RPC libraries read every message the server sends](README.md#two-outside-json-rpc-libraries-read-every-message-the-server-sends)

## Exports from `@buildanagent/protocol`

- `interface ApprovalList`: The answer to `approval/list`.
- `type ApprovalPolicy`: When a sandboxed call may ask a person: on request, by granular rule, or never.
- `interface BranchResult`: The answer to `session/checkout` and `session/fork`: the session now in use and its HEAD.
- `interface CheckoutEntry`: HEAD moved to another entry.
- `CLIENT_METHODS`: The methods a client may call.
- `type ClientCommand`: What a client sends.
- `interface ClientInfo`: Who a client says it is, in `initialize`.
- `type ClientMessage`: Everything a client sends: commands, and answers to the server's requests.
- `interface ClientResultMap`: The result of each client method, by method name.
- `interface CompactionEntry`: A summary replaced older entries in the context a rebuilt run sends.
- `interface CompletionCheckEntry`: The commands that checked a finished task, and whether they passed.
- `decode()`: Reads one message from a line of JSON text or a parsed value, and checks its envelope.
- `DEFAULT_MAX_LINE_BYTES`: The default bound on one line, in bytes.
- `type Disposition`: The answer to a turn command: the server took it, or why it did not.
- `encode()`: Turns a message into one line of JSON ending in `\n`, after the same envelope check `decode()` makes.
- `interface EntryBase`: The fields every entry has, with its `type`.
- `interface EnvStampEntry`: The environment a session ran in.
- `ErrorCodes`: The JSON-RPC error codes the protocol uses: the standard ones, and three of its own in the server-error range.
- `EXPERIMENTAL_METHODS`: The client methods that need an opt-in, because they may change before a client other than ours uses them.
- `interface ExtensionLoadedEntry`: An extension was loaded, with the hash of what ran.
- `FORMAT_VERSION`: The format version of every entry this package writes and reads.
- `type FramedMessage`: One line of the stream: its parsed JSON, or why it could not be read.
- `type HarnessEvent`: What the harness adds to the SDK's events.
- `type Id`: A request id: a number or a string.
- `interface InitializeResult`: The server's answer to `initialize`.
- `interface InterruptResult`: The answer to `turn/interrupt`: whether a turn was running to interrupt.
- `isProtocolError()`: True for a `ProtocolError`, including one from another copy of the package.
- `class JsonlFramer`: Feed it chunks as they arrive.
- `interface JsonlFramerOptions`: The options of `JsonlFramer`.
- `type JsonRpcMessage`: A JSON-RPC message as `decode()` reads it: the envelope is checked, and `params` and `result` are not.
- `interface LoadoutEntry`: The tools and model in force changed.
- `interface MessageBlockEntry`: One content block of a message.
- `interface MessageEndEntry`: A message is complete: which model wrote it and why it stopped.
- `type Origin`: Who produced an entry's content.
- `PACKAGE_NAME`: The package's name.
- `parseEntry()`: Reads one session entry from a JSON line or an already parsed value, and checks what every reader relies on: it is an object with valid base fields, its `type` is in the union, and a `session_header` has this package's `formatVersion`.
- `interface PermissionDecisionEntry`: The permission pipeline's decision on one tool call, written for every decision.
- `type PermissionMode`: How tool calls are decided: `shadow` records what would have happened without doing it.
- `interface ProductRecordEntry`: A record that the product owns.
- `class ProtocolError`: The error every `@buildanagent/protocol` function throws.
- `type ProtocolErrorCode`: Why something was refused.
- `interface ProtocolErrorOptions`: What a `ProtocolError` carries when it is also a JSON-RPC error a peer can be answered with.
- `type ProtocolMessage`: Any message of the protocol, in either direction.
- `type ResponseMessage`: A response: the result of one request, or an error.
- `interface RpcError`: A JSON-RPC error object.
- `type SandboxTier`: How strongly a sandbox isolates a run, from none to a micro-VM.
- `SERVER_NOTIFICATION_METHODS`: The notifications the server sends.
- `SERVER_REQUEST_METHODS`: The requests the server sends.
- `type ServerMessage`: Everything a server sends: answers to commands, requests and notifications.
- `type ServerNotification`: What the server sends without being asked.
- `type ServerRequest`: What the server asks the client for.
- `interface ServerResultMap`: What a server request's client answer holds, by method name.
- `SESSION_ENTRY_TYPES`: The `type` of every entry in the union, in the order the union lists them.
- `type SessionEntry`: One line of a session file.
- `interface SessionHeaderEntry`: The first entry of a session file: what ran the session, and which session it came from.
- `interface SessionList`: The answer to `session/list`.
- `interface SessionListItem`: One session in `session/list`.
- `interface SessionOpened`: The answer to `session/create` and `session/open`.
- `interface ShadowCallEntry`: A call that shadow mode recorded and did not run.
- `interface SkillLoadedEntry`: A skill's instructions entered the context.
- `interface SubagentLinkEntry`: A child session exists.
- `interface ToolResultEntry`: What a tool call returned to the model.
- `interface TurnEndEntry`: A turn ended, with the stop reason of its run.
- `interface TurnResultSummary`: How a turn ended, in `turn/settled`.
- `interface TurnStartEntry`: A turn began.
- `interface UsageEntry`: The tokens and cost of one model call, a summary or a judge call.
